Removed with the legacy server (git rm src/server.ts); the graceful-shutdown gap no longer exists. new-backend uses packages/shared service lifecycle.

Chat admin is now keyed on the immutable profile id via a CHAT_ADMIN_IDS env (plus CHAT_ADMINS by address). Name-based admin removed; a one-time console.warn migration note fires when the legacy display name resolves to an id not yet in CHAT_ADMIN_IDS.

Both Vercel functions now connect with ssl:{rejectUnauthorized:true} (Neon serves a publicly-trusted chain); PG_CA may pin an explicit CA, or sslmode=verify-full in the URL. No rejectUnauthorized:false fallback.

Presence DDL removed from the request path: ensureTable() is a no-op unless PRESENCE_AUTOMIGRATE=1. Added api/presence.sql to create the table once against the Neon CHAT database (kept out of new-backend/db/migrations, which the make-migrate runner would apply to the wrong DB).
whoCache is now keyed on a SHA-256 of the bearer token (never the raw token) and its TTL is capped at min(5min, the JWT's own exp), so a token stops resolving as the profile at/after expiry.

CHAT_ADMIN_KEY compared with crypto.timingSafeEqual over equal-length buffers; the admin-key POST path now has its own per-key sliding-window rate limit (KEY_PER_MINUTE), keyed on a hash of the key. A presented-but-wrong key is rejected, never treated as a user.

consumeNonce split into peekNonce (reads, validates, does NOT delete) and finalizeNonce (GETDEL + Postgres consumed_at guard). proveAddress peeks, verifies the signature, and only finalizes on success — so an unauthenticated caller with a bad signature can no longer burn a victim's challenge. Added auth/__tests__/nonce.test.ts (peek doesn't consume; single-use; replaced-record rejection).

bgio PostgresStore dialectOptions now mirror the shared sslConfig(): disable->no TLS, require->{require:true,rejectUnauthorized:true}, no-verify->{require:true,rejectUnauthorized:false}. The live match-state connection now verifies the CA when PGSSL=require.
CreateBody.mode restricted to 'casual'|'wager'; ranked matches can only be minted by the matchmaker (insertLiveRankedMatch), closing the private-ranked win-trading path.

joinQueue now runs the liveRankedMatchFor check + ensureStanding + enqueue in ONE transaction (enqueue and liveRankedMatchFor made client-aware). The pairer (claimSeed/claimOpponent) excludes any profile with a live ranked match via a NOT EXISTS against game.matches, so a stale queued+seated row is skipped rather than double-seated.

Added listVoidRefundCandidates (escrows with a deposit whose match is 'void' or has sat 'open' past a TTL, with no match_result and no paid/in-flight payout) and a runVoidRefundPass worker sweep that plans a planVoidRefund and drives it through executePayout. Wired into the worker tick. TTL via deps.voidRefundTtlSeconds (default 24h).

On an idempotency-key mismatch (a different decision already owns the escrow), executePayout now returns a 'conflict' claim (reported as state:'pending') instead of driving the foreign decision's legs and calling finalise() with the proposer's plan. Only the owning decision sets the final escrow status.

Replace-by-fee: once a leg has been attempted rbfAfterAttempts times (default 2) without confirming, each pending reconcile re-signs it at the SAME nonce with escalated fees (feeEscalationAttempt), records the new hash BEFORE broadcasting, and reconciles on it. The shared nonce keeps the replacement and the stuck original mutually exclusive, so it cannot double-pay and no longer rebroadcasts identical underpriced bytes forever.

broadcast() now classifies the rejection (classifyBroadcastError): 'already known'/'imported' = duplicate success; 'nonce too low' is disambiguated by looking up OUR hash via getTransactionStatus — found = success, not found = the nonce was consumed by a different tx, so it throws NonceConsumedError (payoutRunner fails the payout for operator reconciliation) instead of returning a false success that wedges the leg pending forever. Unit test added (evmSender.test.ts).

Added a Redis jti revocation set (auth:revoked:<jti>): revokeJti() in packages/shared/src/auth.ts, checked by requireAuth and optionalAuth (fail-open on Redis outage), and /auth/logout now parks the access token's jti for its remaining life so a stolen access token stops working at logout rather than at exp.

loadKeys() now refuses to boot (a) if WAGER_KEY_ENV_FILE points to a key file that is group/other-readable (mode & 0o077, POSIX), and (b) if the escrow/treasury address is one of the documented placeholder keypairs, unless ALLOW_PLACEHOLDER_WAGER_KEYS=1 is set (then a loud warning). Key isolation documented in DEPLOY.md §2a (KMS/HSM + single-tenant host recommendation retained).

ResultRecorder now seeds its cursor from MAX(finished_at) in game.match_results on first tick (minus the sweep overlap) instead of cursor=0, so the first pass after a deploy scans only matches that finished while down rather than re-reading and re-locking every finished match ever stored.

Dropped the tx.from membership gate in verifyDepositTx; ownership is proved solely by the Transfer log's from (transfer.from membership), so a bundler-relayed ERC-4337/smart-account deposit is accepted. Non-linked senders now reject as 'wrong_sender'. deposit.test.ts and transactingAddresses.test.ts updated; a new test asserts the smart-account acceptance path.

Added a headers block to vercel.json for /(.*) with a real CSP (default-src 'self'; explicit connect-src/frame-src for Privy auth.privy.io, the api.ocva.online gateway https+wss, Solana+Robinhood RPC/explorer hosts, the 0.peerjs.com broker https+wss, and stun:/turn:/turns: for voice; img-src 'self' data: blob: https: for user avatars; media-src for the WebRTC stream; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval' for model-viewer/three WASM), plus HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy microphone=(self), frame-ancestors 'none'/X-Frame-Options DENY. Every origin documented in docs/review/csp.md. The stale 'CSP comes from the gateway' comments in src/api/session.ts and .env.production are owned by the client agent (noted in csp.md).

api/presence.ts now connects with ssl:{rejectUnauthorized:true} (PG_CA/verify-full option documented) and keys idCache on a SHA-256 of the bearer token (never the raw token) with the TTL capped at min(5min, JWT exp).
